description: This file defines ORM models and related functions for managing tags and tagged objects within the Apache Superset project, including tag types, object types, and update hooks for various object classes like dashboards, charts, queries, datasets, and favorites.

classes.name: TagType
classes.description: Enumeration for different tag types such as custom, type, owner, and favorited_by.

classes.name: ObjectType
classes.description: Enumeration for object types including query, chart, dashboard, and dataset.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: ORM model representing a tag attached to objects like queries, charts, dashboards, or datasets.

classes.name: TaggedObject
classes.description: ORM model representing the association between an object and a tag.

classes.name: ObjectUpdater
classes.description: Base class providing hooks for updating tags related to objects; subclasses implement owner retrieval.

classes.name: ChartUpdater
classes.description: Subclass of ObjectUpdater for chart objects, retrieves owners from Slice objects.

classes.name: DashboardUpdater
classes.description: Subclass of ObjectUpdater for dashboard objects, retrieves owners from Dashboard objects.

classes.name: QueryUpdater
classes.description: Subclass of ObjectUpdater for query objects, retrieves owner from Query object.

classes.name: DatasetUpdater
classes.description: Subclass of ObjectUpdater for dataset objects, retrieves owners from SqlaTable objects.

classes.name: FavStarUpdater
classes.description: Handles tagging for favorite objects, adding/removing 'favorited_by' tags on insert/delete.

methods.name: get_tag
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Tag with the specified name and type.

methods.name: get_object_type
methods.description: Maps class names to ObjectType enum values.
